cache: direct ConfiguredProvider::decide; Issue Finder cache bypassed; remote caching is uncontrolled
evidence_scope: five frozen public GitHub snapshots; no GitHub refresh
failure_policy: finish and report the current 24-call run, then stop on any failure
http_attempts: production bounded retries retained but HTTP attempts/statuses are not instrumented; successful logical calls do not prove zero 429s or retries
percentile_method: nearest rank ceil(p*n), including failed calls; duration excludes queue, queue starts at common run submission time
provider_lifecycle: fresh production ConfiguredProvider and HTTP clients per run; construction and close excluded from run wall time
purpose: bounded counterbalanced native transport performance experiment; does not measure model quality or tune request semantics

logical_response_usage_totals.scope: sum only of usage returned by logical decide responses, including any later validation failure; missing/error responses and HTTP retry billing are not estimated
